title: How Ryanair makes money on £15 flights

scenes.say: Wait... this Ryanair flight cost me fifteen quid?! The TAXI here cost forty! So how on earth did Ryanair make over two BILLION euros profit last year? Let me show you!
Trick number one! The ticket is just the bait. The real money? Everything else! Bags! Seats! Priority boarding! That's almost FIVE billion euros of extras. Crazy, right?
Trick two! Cheap airports. Ryanair will happily fly you to Paris!
Well... Beauvais! About eighty five kilometres away! Ha! But small airports charge way lower fees, so Ryanair saves millions!
Trick three! One type of plane! Almost every Ryanair jet is a Boeing seven three seven, bought hundreds at a time, for massive discounts! Same parts, same training, cheaper everything!
Trick four! Planes that never stop! A Ryanair jet lands, empties, refills and takes off again in about twenty five minutes! Because a plane on the ground makes zero money!
And trick five! No frills! No free food, no screens, seats that don't even recline! Tiny savings, times two hundred million passengers? That's a fortune!
So that fifteen pound flight isn't a loss at all. It's the hook! Genius, right? Follow for more money secrets!
